messages:
ellie: quick FYI — noticed the JS SDK helper in JSON mode mangles function-call outputs when a retry happens. seen it in bootcamp sample.

sachin: ugh, details? sample app crash or validation error?

ellie: validation error from our schema runner. we expect a parsed object but we sometimes get a string with leading "\n" and an extra escape, e.g. `"{\"choices\":...}"` after a retry.

lina: is this because the retry layer re-encodes the body instead of reusing the parsed result?

ellie: yep. JS path: initial response -> helper parses JSON -> good. On retry, the low-level client returns raw text and our helper calls JSON.parse again on a string that already contains quotes, so we end up double-parsed or a string-wrapped-json.

alex: I saw parity issues here between JS and Py — Py's helper normalizes to object on both cold and retried responses, JS only does that consistently on non-retry.

sachin: can you paste the failing snippet from the logs?

ellie: pasted from local run:
```
2026-11-03T12:03:21Z ERROR bootcamp: schema-validation failed: expected object, got string
response body (retry=1): "\"{\\\"task\\\":\\\"email-draft\\\",\\\"args\\\":{...}}\""
```

lina: oof. looks like the helper assumes the transport will normalize. not safe.

alex: quick workaround for the sample app: in the helper use: `if (typeof r === 'string') r = JSON.parse(r.replace(/^\"|\"$/g, ''))` — hacky but unblocks bootcamp.

sachin: let's not ship hacks. plan: I will open a bug (sdk-js #3456) to update the JS helper to idempotently parse and to add a test covering retry+streaming+function_call. also add a compatibility test matching Python.

ellie: sounds good. can we also add a small migration note in the sample app readme so customers on older SDKs aren't blocked?

sachin: yep — adding README note + changelog entry.

alex: also flagging CI flaky test — SDK-CI bot: @sdk-ci-bot please rerun the js-sdk unit matrix for PR once ready. :crossed_fingers:

sdk-ci-bot: queued run for js-sdk/test-matrix (pr: sdk-js#3456) — will report back. :robot_face:

lina: one more thought — this usually shows up when `jsonMode: true` + `maxRetries > 0` + streaming disabled. should we add a lint rule that warns if sample uses that combo?

sachin: good idea. adding a lint rule and a guard in the helper. estimate: 1d for fix + tests + sample update.

ellie: thanks — assigning to sachin. I'll update bootcamp sample with the temporary workaround and a TODO comment pointing to the issue. :thumbsup:
